roadmap.title: Campaign and dog tags
roadmap.description: Play the nine missions while collecting dog tags and completing each mission challenge. Replay missed sections. Complete Nile Guard on Hardcore for the difficulty achievement.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer classes and objectives
roadmap.description: Use official multiplayer matches. Rotate through Conquest, Breakthrough and Rush, then finish the class tasks. Work on Support revives throughout.

roadmap.title: REDSEC Battle Royale
roadmap.description: Work toward seven Duos wins and one victory with the whole squad alive. Complete map missions and use call-ins during the 74-match total.

roadmap.title: Gauntlet and REDSEC cleanup
roadmap.description: Play Gauntlet for rounds, stuns, revives and enemy dog tags. The REDSEC revive total is separate from the normal multiplayer Support task.

achievements.description: Complete Always Faithful
achievements.summary: Finish Always Faithful.

steps.text: Finish the first campaign mission, @loc{Always Faithful}.

achievements.description: Complete The Rock and Operation Gladius
achievements.summary: Finish The Rock and Operation Gladius.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Rock}, then @loc{Operation Gladius}.

achievements.description: Complete Night Raid
achievements.summary: Finish Night Raid.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Night Raid}.

achievements.description: Complete No Sleep and Moving Mountains
achievements.summary: Finish No Sleep and Moving Mountains.

steps.text: Finish @loc{No Sleep}, then @loc{Moving Mountains}.

achievements.description: Complete Nile Guard
achievements.summary: Finish Nile Guard.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Nile Guard}.

achievements.description: Complete Operation Ember Strike
achievements.summary: Finish Operation Ember Strike.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Operation Ember Strike}.

achievements.description: Complete the Battlefield 6 Campaign
achievements.summary: Finish all nine campaign missions.

steps.text: Finish the final mission, @loc{Always Forward}.

achievements.description: Pick up a Campaign collectible
achievements.summary: Collect one dog tag in the campaign.

steps.text: In @loc{Always Faithful}, take the dog tag from the ammunition crate beside the sniper squad. If you pass the tag, replay Always Faithful.

achievements.description: Pick up 5 Campaign collectibles
achievements.summary: Collect five dog tags in the campaign.

guide.context: Use the Pack Leader checklist for the locations. If a tag is left behind, replay its mission.

steps.text: Collect the three tags in @loc{Always Faithful}, then the starting tag and museum radio-desk tag in @loc{The Rock}.

achievements.description: Pick up 10 Campaign collectibles
achievements.summary: Collect ten dog tags in the campaign.

guide.context: Use the Pack Leader checklist for the locations. If a tag is left behind, replay its mission.

steps.text: Collect the nine tags in the first three missions, then the upstairs palace bathroom tag in @loc{Night Raid}.

achievements.description: Pick up 20 Campaign collectibles
achievements.summary: Collect twenty dog tags in the campaign.

guide.context: Use the Pack Leader checklist for the locations. If a tag is left behind, replay its mission.

steps.text: Collect every tag through @loc{Moving Mountains}. The twentieth is beside the dead soldier up the park stairs after the subway.

achievements.description: Pick up all Campaign collectibles
achievements.summary: Collect all 30 dog tags in the campaign.

guide.context: If you advance past a dog tag, replay its mission to collect it.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 1
collectibles.method: Collect the tag from the ammunition crate beside the sniper squad.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 2
collectibles.method: At the second planting objective, look left toward the windows. Take the tag hanging from a knife in the opposite pillar.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 3
collectibles.method: Turn left immediately after climbing the rope and collect the blinking tag.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 4
collectibles.method: Turn around at mission start and check the blue box beside the coastal gun.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 5
collectibles.method: Pass the aircraft and go downstairs. Collect the tag beside the headset on the radio desk.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 6
collectibles.method: Check the shipping container with the ammunition crate near the second gun. Take the tag from the container door.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 7
collectibles.method: After leaving the armored vehicle, collect the tag from the box beside the defensive machine gun near the radio position.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 8
collectibles.method: On the upper floor, check the outdoor table with wine bottles before opening the door toward the overwatch position.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 9
collectibles.method: Enter the small room left of the stairs. Collect the tag hanging from a knife in the wall.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 10
collectibles.method: After the palace fire, go upstairs. Enter the room ahead and turn left into the bathroom. Take the tag from the knife in the wall.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 11
collectibles.method: Leave the shop after escaping the searchlight. At the football field, find the stairs in the distant right corner and take the tag.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 12
collectibles.method: At the Proceed to the plaza objective, enter the open shop with white-shirt mannequins. Collect the tag from its table.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 13
collectibles.method: When the helicopter returns, go downstairs. Check left of the stairs beside the desk with two monitors.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 14
collectibles.method: Inside the briefing container, collect the tag from the table on your left.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 15
collectibles.method: After the cutscene with Kincaid on the tablet, check the board on the right for a knife holding the tag.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 16
collectibles.method: After the tunnel drive and train crash, enter the blue shipping container near the truck. Check the table inside.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 17
collectibles.method: After the presidential cutscene, take the hallway right of the stairs instead of going upstairs. Collect the tag from the cafeteria counter.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 18
collectibles.method: During the search for drone operators, look left in the construction zone for a single-room building. Go inside and collect the tag beside the boots on the floor.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 19
collectibles.method: After the underground vehicle crash, reach the lit station platform. Check beside the toy rabbit and green bag near the central concrete block.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 20
collectibles.method: Take the left path past the burning food cart and climb the park stairs. Collect the tag beside the dead soldier.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 21
collectibles.method: After leaving the tank, walk through the first building. In the courtyard beyond it, collect the tag beneath the right-hand tree.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 22
collectibles.method: Before approaching the crashed helicopter, enter the building on the right with blue chairs outside. Take the tag from the wall by the posters.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 23
collectibles.method: At the cluster of three buildings, enter the middle building. Check the floor beneath the left window.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 24
collectibles.method: In the area with three objectives, head toward Bravo and find the building with a goat painted outside. Check the crate by its left window.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 25
collectibles.method: After the Switchblade defense, reach the open gate at Disable the SAM network. Climb to the former sniper position on the left and check the crate.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 26
collectibles.method: After regrouping with Murphy, climb toward the parked quad bikes. Check the crate beside the forklift.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 27
collectibles.method: Enter the hangar containing trucks and check the floor beside the bag.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 28
collectibles.method: After leaving the building near the antenna, check the concrete block beside the sandbags.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 29
collectibles.method: Inside the later hangar, check the crates in its far-left rear corner.

collectibles.name: Dog tag 30
collectibles.method: After the bunker cutscene, check the crate on the left while facing the objective marker.

achievements.description: Complete a Single Player mission on the hardest difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish one campaign mission on Hardcore difficulty.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Hardcore} for @loc{Nile Guard}. Stay behind allied tanks and use repair stations during the vehicle section.
In the final on-foot fight, stay in cover and let your squad help clear enemies before finishing the mission.

achievements.description: Headshot kill 50 Enemies in the Campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 campaign enemies with headshots.

guide.context: Headshot kills accumulate across missions and replays.

steps.text: Aim for the head during campaign fights. Replay the opening combat in @loc{Moving Mountains} to finish the total.

achievements.description: Eliminate 3 enemies with a single grenade in Single Player
achievements.summary: Kill at least three campaign enemies with one grenade.

steps.text: In @loc{Always Faithful}, throw a grenade into the enemies grouped near the sniper rendezvous jeep. Reload the checkpoint if fewer than three die.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 enemy vehicles in Single Player
achievements.summary: Destroy ten enemy vehicles in the campaign.

steps.text: Use the tank in @loc{Nile Guard} to destroy enemy vehicles until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Collect the dinosaur figurine at the NATO base in Always Faithful.
achievements.summary: Collect the dinosaur figurine at the NATO base in Always Faithful.

guide.context: If you leave the barracks without the figurine, replay Always Faithful.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Always Faithful}, turn around in the barracks. Crouch beside the table and pick up the dinosaur.

achievements.description: Destroy ten mannequins during The Rock.
achievements.summary: Destroy ten mannequins during The Rock.

guide.context: If you leave the museum too early, replay The Rock.

steps.text: In the underground museum in @loc{The Rock}, wait until shooting becomes available again. Shoot ten mannequins in the dark combat rooms.

achievements.description: Destroy three floating mines during Operation Gladius.
achievements.summary: Destroy three floating mines during Operation Gladius.

guide.context: Reaching shore ends this opportunity. Restart Operation Gladius if you miss the mines.

steps.text: During the opening water crossing in @loc{Operation Gladius}, use the turret to shoot three black mines with flashing red lights.

achievements.description: Finish Night Raid using only pistols, knives and gadgets.
achievements.summary: Finish Night Raid using only pistols, knives and gadgets.

guide.context: Firing a forbidden weapon invalidates the run. Restart Night Raid to try again.

steps.text: Keep your starting pistol throughout @loc{Night Raid}. Use pistols or knives for enemies; avoid rifles and grenades.
Use the supplied RPG to destroy the required helicopter, then finish the mission.
If the unlock is delayed, continue until you can move in No Sleep. Return to the menu, select Night Raid and choose Continue to replay its ending.

achievements.description: Kill five enemies with the sledgehammer during No Sleep.
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies with the sledgehammer during No Sleep.

guide.context: If you finish with fewer than five sledgehammer kills, replay No Sleep.

steps.text: After receiving the sledgehammer at the townhouse breach in @loc{No Sleep}, use melee attacks to kill five enemies. Check upstairs after clearing the first rooms.

achievements.description: Hit six consecutive enemy headshots during Moving Mountains.
achievements.summary: Hit six consecutive enemy headshots during Moving Mountains.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Moving Mountains}, wait for enemies to stop behind cover. Fire six shots that all hit enemy heads. Reload the checkpoint after a miss or body hit.

achievements.description: Destroy a tank by collapsing the overpass during Nile Guard.
achievements.summary: Destroy a tank by collapsing the overpass during Nile Guard.

guide.context: If the tank dies before the bridge collapses, reload the checkpoint and retry.

steps.text: At the first checkpoint in @loc{Nile Guard}, use the tank cannon on the right-hand bridge support while an enemy tank is on the overpass.

achievements.description: Mark twenty enemies with the drone during Operation Ember Strike.
achievements.summary: Mark twenty enemies with the drone during Operation Ember Strike.

guide.context: Killing enemies before marking them can leave too few targets. Replay Operation Ember Strike if you finish short of twenty.

steps.text: Deploy the recon drone in @loc{Operation Ember Strike}. Aim at enemies to mark them before attacking, until twenty have been spotted.

achievements.description: Shoot down a reinforcement helicopter with a tank during Always Forward.
achievements.summary: Shoot down a reinforcement helicopter with a tank during Always Forward.

steps.text: After the first missile bunker in @loc{Always Forward}, enter the Abrams and drive toward NXC launcher Bravo.
Before the road turns right, shoot down the arriving troop helicopter with the tank cannon. Reload the checkpoint if the helicopter escapes.

achievements.description: Reach Rank 9
achievements.summary: Reach multiplayer player rank 9.

steps.text: Earn multiplayer XP from combat, objectives and team actions until your player rank reaches 9.

achievements.description: Reach Rank 14
achievements.summary: Reach multiplayer player rank 14.

steps.text: Earn multiplayer XP from combat, objectives and team actions until your player rank reaches 14.

achievements.description: Reach Rank 25
achievements.summary: Reach multiplayer player rank 25.

steps.text: Earn multiplayer XP from combat, objectives and team actions until your player rank reaches 25.

achievements.description: Capture 128 objectives in Conquest
achievements.summary: Capture 128 objectives in Conquest.

steps.text: Stay inside enemy or neutral flag zones in @mechanic{Conquest} until your team finishes capturing them. Reach 128 captures across matches.

achievements.description: Take or Defend 41 sectors in Breakthrough
achievements.summary: Capture or defend 41 sectors in Breakthrough.

guide.context: The counter counts sectors rather than individual flags.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Breakthrough}. On attack, help take every objective in a sector; on defense, stop the attackers taking the sector. Reach 41 sector captures or defenses.

achievements.description: Arm or disarm 5 M-COM explosives in a Multiplayer match
achievements.summary: Arm or disarm five M-COM explosives within one multiplayer match.

steps.text: In one @mechanic{Rush} match, arm enemy M-COMs or disarm charges planted on your team’s M-COMs five times. Use smoke to cover the interaction.

achievements.description: Get 5 multi-kills as Assault in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Earn five multiplayer multi-kill awards while playing Assault.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Assault}, attack groups near Breakthrough objectives. Get five rapid kills to trigger a Marauder award, keeping gaps between kills within about eight seconds.
Earn a Marauder award in five separate five-kill sequences while playing Assault.

achievements.description: Repair vehicles for 2042 damage in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: As Engineer, restore 2,042 damage to friendly multiplayer vehicles occupied by another teammate.

guide.context: Repairs to an empty vehicle do not earn the repair score needed for this counter.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Engineer}, use the repair tool on a damaged friendly vehicle with a teammate inside. Keep repairing occupied vehicles until you restore 2,042 damage.

achievements.description: Get 250 sniper rifle kills as Recon in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 250 multiplayer enemies with sniper rifles while playing Recon.

steps.text: Equip a sniper rifle as @mechanic{Recon} and use that rifle for 250 kills across multiplayer matches.

achievements.description: Revive 1996 players as Support in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Revive 1,996 players as Support in multiplayer.

guide.context: The Profile revive total includes other classes, which do not count toward this Support achievement.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Support} in Breakthrough and use the Defibrillator on downed teammates. Keep reviving across matches until you reach 1,996.

achievements.description: Commit 414 acts of valor in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Perform 414 acts of valor in multiplayer.

steps.text: Kill enemies who are shooting at your teammates to earn Savior awards. Keep protecting teammates across multiplayer matches.

achievements.description: Get 5 kills with LMGs without reloading in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill five multiplayer enemies with an LMG without reloading.

steps.text: Equip a high-capacity LMG and fight near a busy Breakthrough objective. Aim for five rapid kills while staying alive, keeping the same weapon equipped and avoiding reloads.

achievements.description: Get 6 sidearm headshot kills in a Multiplayer match
achievements.summary: Kill six multiplayer enemies with sidearm headshots within one match.

steps.text: Choose Conquest or Breakthrough for a longer match. Use your pistol to headshot six enemies, aiming at stationary or distracted targets.

achievements.description: Get a Roadkill with vehicles in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Run over and kill one enemy with a vehicle in multiplayer.

steps.text: Drive a tank, light transport or ATV into an enemy soldier to score a roadkill.

achievements.displayName: A Little C-4 Knocking on Your Door
achievements.description: Deal 2000 damage to enemy vehicles with the Demolition Charge
achievements.summary: Use Demolition Charges to inflict 2,000 total damage on enemy vehicles in multiplayer.

steps.text: Open Challenges > Assignments > Class > Recon and finish the displayed @mechanic{Recon 1} requirements to unlock Demolition Charge.
Equip @item{Demolition Charge} on Recon. Stick charges to enemy vehicles, preferably on side or rear armor, and detonate them. Deal 2,000 damage across matches.

achievements.description: Perform 10 takedowns in a Multiplayer match
achievements.summary: Perform ten takedowns within one multiplayer match.

steps.text: Choose Conquest or Breakthrough for a longer match. Flank distracted enemies and melee from behind to trigger takedowns. Perform ten before the match ends, using smoke to hide your approach.

achievements.description: Get 129 kills in Multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Kill 129 enemies across multiplayer matches.

steps.text: Get kills in multiplayer until your career total reaches 129.

achievements.displayName: May the Odds Forever Be in Your Favor
achievements.description: Complete 74 Battle Royale matches.
achievements.summary: Complete 74 Battle Royale matches.

steps.text: Play Battle Royale Duos or Quads until your squad wins or is fully eliminated. Complete 74 matches; do not leave while squadmates can still continue.

achievements.description: Use a total of 42 Battle Royale call-ins.
achievements.summary: Use a total of 42 Battle Royale call-ins.

steps.text: Collect call-ins from rare chests or mission rewards. Activate each call-in with its marker grenade or laser designator, reaching 42 deployments across matches.

achievements.description: Loot ten Superior or Custom items in Battle Royale.
achievements.summary: Loot ten Superior or Custom items in Battle Royale.

steps.text: Pick up gold Superior items, such as Vehicle Key Cards or Intel XP, and red Custom weapons from Custom Weapon Drops. Loot ten items across Battle Royale matches.

achievements.description: Inflict 316 enemy stuns across Battle Royale or Gauntlet games.
achievements.summary: Inflict 316 enemy stuns across Battle Royale or Gauntlet games.

steps.text: Equip a stun grenade as @mechanic{Assault} in Gauntlet. Throw it into groups of enemies, then use your replenished grenades after respawning. Reach 316 enemy stuns across matches.

achievements.description: Revive teammates 1,988 times in Battle Royale or Gauntlet.
achievements.summary: Revive teammates 1,988 times in Battle Royale or Gauntlet.

guide.context: Normal multiplayer revives do not count toward this REDSEC total. The Profile counter combines both modes.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Support} in Gauntlet with a Defibrillator. Revive downed squadmates throughout your matches until you reach 1,988.

achievements.description: Win seven Battle Royale Duos matches.
achievements.summary: Win seven Battle Royale Duos matches.

steps.text: Play Battle Royale Duos with a partner and stay close enough to support each other. Earn seven victories across your matches.

achievements.description: Play 125 rounds of Gauntlet.
achievements.summary: Play 125 rounds of Gauntlet.

steps.text: Play Gauntlet and continue into each available round until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Win a Battle Royale match with every member of a full squad alive.
achievements.summary: Win a Battle Royale match with every member of a full squad alive.

guide.context: Deaths earlier in the match are allowed if every squad member is alive at victory.

steps.text: Enter Battle Royale Duos or Quads with a full squad. Revive or redeploy fallen squadmates and secure the win with everyone alive.

achievements.description: Finish 214 missions in Battle Royale.
achievements.summary: Finish 214 missions in Battle Royale.

steps.text: Open the Battle Royale map. Inspect a nearby mission’s objective, distance and timer, then accept the mission.
For a safe mission, collect the marked bolt cutters, then open the marked safe. Finish 214 missions across matches; failed attempts do not count.

achievements.description: Collect a total of nine enemy dog tags while playing Battle Royale or Gauntlet.
achievements.summary: Collect a total of nine enemy dog tags while playing Battle Royale or Gauntlet.

steps.text: Use a rear melee takedown or melee-execute a downed enemy in Battle Royale or Gauntlet. Collect nine enemy dog tags across matches.

achievements.description: Ping one shotgun in Battle Royale.
achievements.summary: Ping one shotgun in Battle Royale.

steps.text: Aim at a shotgun lying on the ground in Battle Royale and use the ping command to mark it for your squad.
